annotations.title: Check your Soclo credits and plan

description: Read the connected account’s credit balance, current plan (tier, state, renewal, monthly allotment) and recent credit ledger rows (newest first, with signed movement, reason, resulting balance and spend receipt id). A spend is negative, a failed-job return is a positive refund, and a store refund/chargeback removing credits is a negative reversal — read the sign, not the label alone. Read-only and free. Balance and ledger are adjacent reads rather than one snapshot. The ledger confirms what was actually spent or refunded, so read it after a failed or interrupted generation before reporting cost; if ledgerUnavailable is returned, state that the ledger could not be read rather than claiming nothing was spent. Check the balance before starting video generation runs so work does not stop midway. Wallet credits do not cap advertising spend on Meta or Google, which sits outside Soclo credits.
